Definition: a primary word; life, i.e. (literally) the present state of existence; by implication, the means of livelihood:--good, life, living.
BiblicalUsage: Life here is not the soul's life but the life of this world — what a man lives on, and what he lives for. In Luke 8:14 the seed is choked by the cares and riches and pleasures of this life, in Luke 15:12 the prodigal asks for the portion of goods that falleth to him, in Luke 21:4 the widow casts in all the living that she had, and in 1 John 2:16 the pride of life is named as not of the Father.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this word is a warning about the wrong kind of life: the living that chokes, the pride that is not of the Father, and the widow who gave it all away anyway.
